paper: Demystifying the Information Reconciliation Protocol Cascade, arXiv:1407.3257v2

concepts_considered.title: Observable-adaptive finite-frame reconciliation
concepts_considered.difficulty: Joint leakage, latency, reliability and channel-estimation uncertainty; a good fixed schedule is supplied.

concepts_considered.title: Activated residual trap under fixed shuffles
concepts_considered.difficulty: Sparse adversarial discrepancy search across overlapping parity partitions and two legal cascade orders; construction knowledge is private.

concepts_considered.title: Budgeted parity experiment design
concepts_considered.difficulty: Adaptive experiment selection and inference under a small disclosure budget with heterogeneous residual mechanisms.

concepts_considered.title: Rare residual-error probability prediction
concepts_considered.reason: A reliable tail-probability label corpus needs considerably more simulation and importance-sampling validation; ordinary heldout labels risk an irreducible-noise target.

concepts_considered.title: Balanced confirmation matrix construction
concepts_considered.reason: Small-error guarantees without further restrictions collapse to standard BCH code construction; extra hardware restrictions would be less directly paper-seeded.

concepts_considered.title: Repair batched cached-parity engine
concepts_considered.reason: Earlier local pilot failed to submit, not demonstrated algorithmic hardness; rebuilding another repair task risks reproducing an existing implementation.

concepts_considered.title: Optimize fixed first-three block sizes
concepts_considered.reason: The paper supplies a direct low-dimensional search and near-optimal schedules; a competent sweep would likely suffice.

concepts_considered.title: Refute zero-failure BICONF simulation claim
concepts_considered.reason: Unrestricted Monte Carlo eventually supplies a counterexample with a standard known mechanism; little investigation needed.

concepts_considered.title: Latency-aware parity-batch schedule
concepts_considered.reason: For fixed dependency DAGs this risks becoming one scheduling algorithm rather than a scientific Cascade challenge.

prior_pilot.finding: An earlier 600-second model pilot produced no submission. Its score is not used as evidence for the new tournament.
